outsiders.name: Pika
outsiders.text:
Today, we’re excited to share Enact, a research preview of scenes that respond to you.

Enact represents a new way of making AI video, one that’s designed to mimic the experience of directing on set. Built on Pika H3 Flex, it allows a creator to interact with “actors,” manually re-stage a scene, and manipulate the camera—all in real time.

We think this is the beginning of a new paradigm for creation. Read more and reach out for a demo below.
outsiders.original_en:
Today, we’re excited to share Enact, a research preview of scenes that respond to you.

Enact represents a new way of making AI video, one that’s designed to mimic the experience of directing on set. Built on Pika H3 Flex, it allows a creator to interact with “actors,” manually re-stage a scene, and manipulate the camera—all in real time.

We think this is the beginning of a new paradigm for creation. Read more and reach out for a demo below.
outsiders.hook: Launch: Pika Enact, a research preview where you direct AI 'actors', re-stage a scene and move the camera in real time (Pika H3 Flex) - 409.7K views, 1,385 likes, 1,013 bookmarks; reach looks boosted (0.3% like rate) and was echoed by a wave of near-identical creator posts.
outsiders.video_tip: Act it out yourself: a 20s 'directing' skit where you shout notes at a Space Marine who keeps misreading them - the 'directing AI actors' idea is the hook of the week.
outsiders.draft_en:
Pika Enact is out as a research preview, and it treats AI video like a film set instead of a prompt box.

You talk to the "actors", move people around the scene yourself and steer the camera while it all runs live. Under the hood sits Pika H3 Flex.

If this works, AI filmmaking starts to feel like directing. Details and demo requests are linked below.

there is a GTA 6 mod for AI video models: Imagine MCP x @claudeai's Fable 5.2.

hear us out. gameplay videos are hard to recreate, even with Seedance 2.5. why? unlike AI models, NPCs are not strictly physics-faithful.

outsiders.name: Raven Morgoth
outsiders.text:
If you’re struggling with continuous fails from Seedance 2.5 while animating complex scenes, try blocking them in Blender first. I just started working with Claude Fable 5.2 and Blender, and the results have completely changed my workflow. Simple 3D blocking with the right Seedance instructions produces shots I couldn’t get through prompting alone (SD failed almost every time)
Blender previs and Seedance 2.5 gives you beautiful photorealistic output. I’m absolutely blown away by this approach

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
